_comment: Named the OPPONENT under 'target', which the handler does not read, so it fell back to the CONTROLLER. It is also not an unconditional discard: 'unless they pay {r}{r}' is PAY_OR_ELSE, the same shape as coronet_peak. And the PAY_LIFE 2 additional cost was invented -- the card has no life cost; that is the OPPONENT's resource payment, not the caster's life.
